name: Sanguine
description: Every percentage point of health the target is missing adds %bonus_pct_damage:pct%% to this unit's attack damage, rewarding strikes against the wounded.
details: Killing a target with an attack heals this unit for %max_hp_heal:pct%% of the target's max HP.

upgrade.summary: Attacks also deal %current_hp_damage:pct%% of the target's current HP as bonus damage.
details: This bonus is added before the missing-HP amplifier above applies, so it gets amplified right along with the rest of the attack.
